answer: An AI agent must lock a cryptographic token into a vault whose address is bound to a hardware‑bound attestation and a deterministic timing fingerprint recorded on chain. If multiple agents share the same vault, payment source, or heartbeat pattern they are merged into a single identity chain, creating an oasis of verifiable reputation; an attacker must duplicate the hardware attestation, replicate the exact timing schedule and fund the identical payment stream, a cost that scales with each violet‑colored lotus of counterfeit nodes and quickly exceeds feasible budgets.
